template_policy: One conversation per selected ordered pair; query and response independently balanced within each split and the single task subgroup
split_policy: Preserve inherited train/val assignments; split only new complete components by seeded 90/10 group allocation; never split endpoints or change old corpus
structure_policy: Explicit full raw cells, pure geometry and identity symmetry operation only; negative-handed raw cells use a recorded integer basis change
scope: Instruction editing only; no physical stability, DFT property, or relaxation-trajectory assertions
